messages:
Noah (CSM): flagging MapleRetail (acct: maple-187) — onboarding stalled, trial end in 9 days, health dropped to 44. seeing repeated auth failures in logs. :warning:
OpsBot: Alert: account maple-187 triggered 'auth_errors_3plus' rule. health_score: 67 -> 44 at 3219990000.
Noah (CSM): we should open a preemptive save plan. thinking: narrow workshop + fallback downgrade bridge + credit + feedback capture. want to keep it standardized so AMs can reuse.
Priya (AM): agree. include a clear downgrade bridge so they don't churn on billing surprise. what do you suggest?
Noah (CSM): Draft downgrade bridge: 1) Offer "Onboarding Pause" — freeze trial billing + extend trial 30 days; 2) If they need permanent downgrade, map to "Starter Core" (lower quota, archival access only) with 20% discount for next billing cycle; 3) Provide a 1-week dedicated support window (office hours). Document acceptance flow and opt-in link.
Rex (Support): I'll create a priority ticket (SUP-5221) and attach the auth error logs. Can we require they use staging keys for the pairing to avoid token leakage?
Jules (Enablement): I'll run a 40m live lab focused on: token/auth flow (10m), sample SDK call + error reproduction (15m), embedding quickstart (10m), next steps (5m). I can also record a 6-min fallback video.
Tara (RevOps): tagging account: "save_plan_active" = true, start_ts=3219990000 for cohort reporting. Also will need a revenue impact row for approval if we give credits.
Noah (CSM): proposing $400 credit and two 1-hour pairing slots. fallback credit if they decline live = $150 async credit.
Priya (AM): $400 ok if we see a reasonable chance of retention. add a KPI: health >= 65 and first 3 successful calls within 7 days post-session, or move to downgrade bridge.
Rex (Support): SUP-5221 created and assigned to eng-oncall. I'll paste sample log snippet: ```{"timestamp":"2026-03-15T10:12:04Z","error":"invalid_token","request_id":"req_9b3"}```
Noah (CSM): outreach template I'm about to send: "Hey MapleRetail — we noticed auth errors during onboarding. Want to book a 40m pairing to get you across the finish line. We can also offer a short credit and extend your trial while we help." ping here once scheduled.
Priya (AM): Also include a quick waiver in the email describing the downgrade bridge terms so they don't feel trapped.
Jules (Enablement): Workshop agenda uploaded to drive. I'll include an SDK snippet for npm and curl. snippet: ```js // npm example
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'mini-gen', input: 'hi' });```
Rex (Support): Note: include SDK version check (>=2.3.0) in runbook. I'll add that to SUP-5221.
OpsBot: Note added: save_plan_active flag set. Next health probe scheduled: 3219990720 (+12h).
Noah (CSM): Action owners: Noah = customer outreach + feedback form; Jules = run workshop + async clip; Rex = support ticket + logs; Priya = downgrade bridge approval + AM follow-up; Tara = tagging + revenue row.
Noah (CSM): Feedback capture: short form after session: 1) primary blocker (select: auth, SDK, infra, docs); 2) did pairing resolve it? (yes/no); 3) what one improvement would help? Capture verbatim in SUP-5221.
Priya (AM): if customer declines both live and async, we send downgrade bridge offer automatically and schedule a 1-week check-in.
Noah (CSM): Outreach sent. MapleRetail replied: "Thanks — Tue 2pm PST works. We can use staging keys."
Jules (Enablement): Confirmed Tue 2pm. I'll prepare lab and recording.
Rex (Support): Pairing slot blocked and on-call notified. SUP-5221 updated with staging access instructions.
Tara (RevOps): I'll provision the $400 credit once SUP-5221 has session notes and AM sign-off. please paste the session note here after session.
Noah (CSM): closing for now. post-session check-in scheduled at 3219994320 (+12h after session). If health doesn't meet KPI we'll proceed to downgrade bridge steps and loop in legal for contract amendments. Thanks team :handshake:
